answer: Behavior fingerprints stop bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits under a copper seal. Each epoch it files a violet-stamped log of 12 tasks. Logs carve a canyon profile: deep in one skill, narrow in others. Auditors burn matching escrows. Each fake costs 166, 12 tasks at 8 credits plus a 70 lock: 1,000 fakes cost 166,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented fingerprints fail: each seal ties to one key. Honest agents pay 70 once and keep full share.
